# `aube doctor`

- **Usage:** `aube doctor [-J --json]`
- **Effect:** read-only

Run broad install-health diagnostics

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

## Examples

```sh
aube doctor
aube doctor --json
```

Read the [workflow guide](/troubleshooting) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Flags

- **`-J --json`** — Emit a machine-readable JSON report instead of the grouped text.
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
